q1_issues.issue: (Inheritance cold_threshold threshold) is an orphan: cold_threshold is a NOUN modifier of cold_threshold_stretch and so is never exposed as a modifier genus, leaving the symbol unreferenced anywhere else in the parse, and decomposing it is a second pass past the 'decompose once, to single-word lemmas, then stop' bar.

q2_gaps: Nested / three-part compound ('cold-threshold stretches', modifier itself a compound): the instruction set says to decompose once to single-word lemmas and never to expose a noun modifier, but does not say whether a multi-word noun modifier is itself decomposed, nor how such a sub-symbol would attach if it were.
